Abhidharmakośa-bhāsya.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Abhidharmakośa-bhāsya.question: This work was very influential on subsequent _____ texts (which imitated its style) and various commentaries were written on it

Alfonso Cano.fact: Cano was shot and killed by army forces on 4 November 2011 in the southwestern Cauca Department in what the Colombian government dubbed "Operation Odysseus." President Juan Manuel Santos confirmed his death on television, claiming the Colombian army dealt the FARC "the biggest blow in the history" of the guerrilla organization. FARC responded to Santos' plea to lay down arms by saying that it would continue its fight against the government.
